messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Use the reference photo only to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body, while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Only use the reference photo to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body, while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands mostly still, then briefly raises his right hand to touch his neck and shoulder area before lowering it and returning to a neutral stance.","camera":"A static, medium shot from the waist up, keeping the subject centered in the frame.","clothing":"A white sleeveless tank top with a large pink and black palm tree graphic and the words \"Los Angeles\" printed on the front, paired with light-colored pants.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair with a slightly textured top.","identity":"A young Black man with a slim build and short hair stands facing the camera.","scene":"An outdoor urban plaza at night, featuring a large glass building with a glowing teal circular neon sign and pink ambient lighting reflecting off the wet pavement."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output person's face appears altered toward the reference identity, with a somewhat smoother and slightly different facial structure. The skin tone on the face and visible body remains broadly similar to the source, with no clearly distinct new skin tone applied. Hairstyle, hair color, clothing, action, scene, and camera remain essentially unchanged.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's facial identity and skin tone with the reference person, applying the reference skin tone consistently to face and body while retaining the original hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Whether the facial identity now matches the reference photo closely enough to be considered a successful replacement.
Whether the reference skin tone was applied consistently to the face and body, since the visible skin tone remains similar to the source.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly cropped or reframed compared with the source, showing less of the surrounding scene at the edges.
